t: The Output Triad: Managing Data, Feedback, and Side Effects in AI-Driven Pipelines
s: This article introduces the 'Output Triad' framework for managing ephemeral, functional, and enduring data types in AI pipelines, using an SEO data engineering project as a case study. It emphasizes human-AI collaboration, particularly in complex, domain-specific systems, and details the integration of external data sources and the generation of keyword filters.
sub: Human-AI collaboration in proprietary system development
Competitive intelligence data scraping and filtering
Managing side effects and external file persistence
